parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Maple Ridge · Silver Valley, Yennadon and the north

North Maple Ridge is an MLS® sub-area name. The City of Maple Ridge doesn’t publish a boundary for it. The City’s neighbourhood list names Albion/Kanaka, Port Hammond, Port Haney, Ruskin, Silver Valley, Thornhill, Town Centre, Webster’s Corners, Whonnock and Yennadon, with no north area.

As a rough guide only, I think of it as roughly 224 Street to 240 Street, north of Dewdney Trunk Road and the Town Centre, up to and across the Alouette River into Silver Valley. That is my reading from the addresses below, not a City boundary, and it overlaps my

. The closest official descriptions are Silver Valley, which the City says is on the north side of the Alouette River and is a gateway to popular recreation areas, and Yennadon, which the City calls an active agricultural production area and a major recreation centre.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 17, 2026. I have worked in Lower Mainland real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Maple Ridge and School District 42.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations, flood rules and school catchments before you buy or sell.

blocks.text: Planning and flood notes for North Maple Ridge

parts.t: Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.
The City adopted the Silver Valley Area Plan update on November 25, 2025. It is Section 10.3 of the Official Community Plan.

The City says it adopted updates to the Official Community Plan and to the Town Centre, Hammond, Silver Valley and Albion area plans in 2025. Albion’s was adopted on October 28 and the others in November.
The City adopted the Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan on January 27, 2026 as Official Community Plan Amending Bylaw No. 7781-2021. It covers Lougheed Highway from Maple Meadows Way to 221 Street.

ALR: I did not find an official statement placing Agricultural Land Reserve land inside North Maple Ridge as a whole. ALR status is set parcel by parcel, so check the exact address on the Agricultural Land Commission map.

The City’s Official Community Plan includes policies to enhance and promote farming on lands designated in the Agricultural Land Reserve, and the City describes Yennadon as an active agricultural production area.
The City publishes a North and South Alouette River Floodplain Map and a Fraser River Floodplain Map, and says a floodplain map outlines the area expected to flood on average once every 200 years.
The City monitors rainfall and water levels in the Fraser River, the North and South Alouette River and Kanaka Creek.
The City says some parts of Maple Ridge face landslides and debris flows, and that melting snowpacks combined with warm weather can create landslides.
I found no flood or slope area named for North Maple Ridge as a whole, so check the City’s maps for the exact address.

The West Coast Express has two Maple Ridge stops, Maple Meadows Station and Port Haney Station, with five trips daily, leaving Maple Ridge in the morning and returning in the evening, Monday to Friday.

TransLink’s Langley–Haney Place Bus Rapid Transit line would run 22 km with 13 stations and service every 10 minutes at peak. TransLink says it is in detailed planning with preliminary funding through the 2025 Investment Plan, and that more funding is needed to deliver it.

Maple Ridge Park is at 13180 232 Street, on the South Alouette River.
Golden Ears Provincial Park is 11 km north of Maple Ridge, reached by Dewdney Trunk Road, 232nd Street and Fern Crescent.
The Maple Ridge Public Library is at 130 – 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road, and it is the only Fraser Valley Regional Library branch in Maple Ridge.
